title: Expression macro
summary: %Debug.log(expr) prints the source of an expression next to its value.

title: Generic function: JSON encoder
summary: Json.encode is called like a function. The compiler makes one encoder per type it is used at.

title: Derive: declarations from a type
summary: @Enum.derive on a variant adds toString, fromString and the list of all values.

title: Derive: lenses for a record
summary: @Lens.derive adds a getter and setter pair per field, with the field's type.

title: Type macro
summary: %Partial.t(user) is the record type user with every field optional.

title: Reading a file at compile time
summary: %I18n.t(key) reads en.json while compiling: a missing key is a compile error, a placeholder an argument.

title: Types from a database schema
summary: %Sql.tables() and %Sql.query("select ...") read schema.sql while compiling: rows are typed records, and a column that does not exist is a compile error.

title: %Macro.eval: compute now
summary: %Macro.eval(expr) runs an expression while compiling and leaves its value in the output.

title: Compile-time arguments
summary: Power.pow(x, 3): x is code, 3 is a value the macro computes with. The loop runs in the compiler.

title: Macros on let and module
summary: @Trace.calls wraps a function; %Units.table generates the contents of a module.

title: Generic by result type: JSON decoder
summary: Decode.fromJson(json) decodes to the type the call site expects.

title: Generic with two arguments: equality
summary: Equal.equal(a, b) is written out field by field for the type of its arguments.

title: A value for every type
summary: Default.value() builds a value from the expected type alone.

title: A record built from data
summary: Convert.to(user) fills a record of the expected type from the fields of another one, an entry per field.

title: Splice holes: lists in a quote
summary: ${...items} stands for any number of record fields, call arguments or switch cases in a quote.

title: Optional fields
summary: %Patch.t(user) makes every field optional and Patch.apply merges a patch: optional fields need no special case.

title: Attributes on generated code
summary: An attribute on the value of a field, and on a whole record: here @warning("-27") for functions the macro writes.

title: Pattern macros and checked literals
summary: %Http.status("ok") is a pattern; %Http.color("#ff8800") is checked and converted while compiling.
